## Objective

Replace the human ontology workbench with the complete local read-only Project Knowledge Explorer defined by approved TRD-20260919-B6D51106 revision 2.

User value: People can understand canonical project definitions, typed relationships, processes and evidence through accessible reading and focused exploration without learning ontology administration or granting action authority.

### Success outcomes

- All 49 TRD requirements and AT-01 through AT-36 retain meaning, qualifiers, dependencies and observable acceptance.
- Actual production reader, source and interactive map/List workflows are local, bounded, snapshot-consistent, accessible and observably non-mutating.
- Reusable source/Template/root delivery preserves independent adoption, canonical knowledge, agent workflows and history with truthful evidence and reversible cutover.

## Scope

### In scope

- Four reading destinations: Overview, Terms, Processes, and Map, with deterministic search, alphabetical/category browsing, stable identity routes, browser history, theme choice, copy actions, and source inspection.
- Canonical, bounded, snapshot-consistent read data; faithful definitions and typed relationships; a focused interactive map with full text equivalence; honest status, gaps, limits, failures, and evidence freshness.
- A dedicated read-only local Python service, protected sessions and sources, offline production assets, explicit launch/build/health contracts, and separation from optional AI, standards, inference, and memory services.
- Future replacement and retirement of the active human workbench; preservation and separate regression verification of agent/CLI authoring, publication, recovery, data, and history.
- Reusable source changes, verified distribution to the neutral Template, separately authorized adoption into the active root, and isolated verification with a second namespace fixture. These are intended delivery boundaries, not grants to perform those actions during plan creation.
- Future unit, service, browser, accessibility, non-mutation, performance, usability, and distribution evidence, covering all SRC AT-01 through AT-36. Proposed targets retain their qualifications below.

### Out of scope

- Ontology editing, drag-to-connect, proposal/review/publication management, inference or query consoles, raw SPARQL, embedding setup, AI chat or generation, agent/skill execution, Task dashboards or mutation, a memory browser, multi-project federation, automatic project scanning, public hosting, collaboration, and hidden Advanced tabs that reintroduce these features are excluded from the first release.

Optional relationship-path search and future Related history expansion are outside this release. Automatic process-flow generation and a second graph library are not required. Missing canonical explanations or ordered steps are displayed honestly; this UI change does not authorize inventing or publishing them. A later content change retains its existing review/authority process.

A complete Logseq fork, embedded Logseq editor/application, copied Logseq graph implementation, production Node server, additional graph database/RDF store, GraphQL service, independently synchronized browser database, implicit package/model/service installation, CDN assets, analytics, cloud logging, external fonts/images, and a general settings workbench are excluded. No bulk update of registered products, historical verification snapshots, or prior initializer editions is authorized.

- This requested plan operation performs no product implementation, dependency installation, runtime launch, Template/root adoption, Git mutation, deployment, external publication or canonical knowledge/memory maintenance.

### Execution authority

Creating or approving this plan records proposed work only and does not itself authorize implementation, installation, deletion, active-root adoption, Git/publication/deployment or another separately governed action. Exact plan approval is required for ready status; future Task execution and each action-specific authority boundary must be recorded before the corresponding planned step.

### Constraints

- This is one future full-release plan; every approved REQ and AT remains in scope. Plan creation is the only currently requested product operation.
- Use current canonical loader/ranking/traversal semantics and strict schemas; do not change the root agent defaults or semantic-search default.
- Reusable product changes belong to SKILLS-depo/ontology and necessary ONTOLOGY-depo contracts/starter assets. Template files are generated destinations, not editing sources.
- Source writing may trigger the existing Template watcher; future implementation must assess its current state, exact mappings and completeness before beginning package edits.
- Root adoption and retirement require a fresh exact source/destination manifest and separate user authority; other projects remain untouched.
- No dependency, model or service installs occur implicitly; Python is the production runtime and any Node tooling is build-only.
- Keep canonical knowledge and evidence stale warnings honest; browsing never repairs provenance or queries memory.
- Native/server/runtime/browser/manual evidence states remain distinct; a qualified target is not a guarantee or a passing result.
- Current helper/source observations establish a planning baseline, not product acceptance. TASK-001 refreshes the baseline before product edits; linked-source content classification, dependency selection and all runtime evidence remain explicit future gates. A material new fact returns the affected design to review.
- Ship manifest-owned production files under explorer/assets; current Template exclusions for dist, build, node_modules and caches remain effective. Stage build output privately before publishing the complete source-owned asset manifest.
- Prior initializer edition receipts/resources retain their historical meaning. Current explorer capability inventory must explicitly replace the current dependency on old workbench assets before active retirement.
- Protected-path preservation includes knowledge/history and unrelated tracker state. Only the exact implementing Task and selected plan may receive their owner-governed tracking updates; this does not grant changes to other Tasks or plans. New release evidence belongs only to the named Verification release directory.

## Decisions

| Decision | Status | Statement | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DEC-001` | `proposed` | Use a small TypeScript application with semantic HTML/CSS and no additional UI framework, Cytoscape.js behind a renderer-only adapter, and Vite for explicit static builds. Select and pin current versions, built-in layout and notices after primary-source compatibility/license review; do not copy Logseq code or install anything as part of planning. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-002` | `proposed` | Add a dedicated Python reader service under ontology_explorer.py with explicit read dispatcher, separate service identity sys4ai-project-knowledge-explorer, and explore --open launch operation. A separate explorer-health probe reports narrow selected-context facts; old workbench command returns a deprecation error naming explore and rejects legacy authoring/grant arguments. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-003` | `proposed` | Use authenticated same-origin JSON POST reads at /api/explorer/v1/context, /api/explorer/v1/search, /api/explorer/v1/entry, /api/explorer/v1/relationships, /api/explorer/v1/neighborhood and /api/explorer/v1/source; bootstrap/session exchange is separate. GET serves only explicit runtime bundle assets and a minimal non-sensitive service health identity. Validate exact versioned request/response envelopes; expose no generic execution, caller root or authority dispatch. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-004` | `proposed` | Add optional strict ontology-explorer.yaml presentation/limits configuration with neutral ONTOLOGY-depo starter/schema and explicit Template mapping. Missing configuration uses validated safe presentation defaults from the selected canonical project only; invalid or wrong-project configuration blocks reads. Category/start mappings refer to exact validated IDs, define display terminology only, and never become canonical knowledge or implicit hierarchy. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-005` | `proposed` | Materialize immutable canonical views with complete selected-input/module/source/helper/configuration/presentation digests and read-only observation of existing publication coordination. Before and after materialization, require stable version inputs and no active or unresolved selected-input publication transaction, including stable partial commits and lock missing-to-present races. Retry at most twice within the request deadline, then return knowledge_updating; do not create/acquire write-creating locks or invoke publication/recovery. An old coherent view may remain visible only with its original snapshot and clear update warning. Missing coordination proof fails closed, while stale source evidence alone does not erase safe recorded definitions. Cache a bounded current/retiring set and release retired views when readers finish. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-006` | `proposed` | Preserve canonical normalize/match/ranked semantics with semantic=False only for ordinary explorer search. Filter visibility/category/lifecycle before keyset pagination and project compact summaries. Use size-bounded, expiring HMAC cursors authenticated by a per-service-start secret and bound to service instance, reading session, resolved root/project, snapshot, normalized query/filter/direction/sort and last stable key. Validate scope against the active session on every page; cursors are not authentication or source/write authority and become invalid after service restart or a fresh reading session. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-007` | `proposed` | Use one normalized node/edge model for renderer and accessible relationship list. Initial one-step view evaluates about 25 nodes/50 edges; cumulative display ceiling evaluates 100 nodes/200 edges separately from tighter agent/API/byte/visited-node limits. Keep direction, every canonical relation ID and all qualifiers; unknown totals/hasMore stay unknown. The normalized data and List own no renderer dependency; renderer code consumes the same model and emits intentions through the shared read/state layer. A renderer import/layout failure leaves List, entry and source actions usable. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-008` | `proposed` | Use canonical stable-ID routes and browser history for deliberate navigation; bootstrap is consumed and removed before normal routing/copy. Selection, focus, query/filters, snapshot, expanded IDs, source selection and preferences remain separate. Preserve context on expiry/conflict/errors, reject late responses, lazy-load/dispose renderer resources, and keep source bodies in memory only. Implement the common API client, state transitions, snapshot conflict handling and encoded stable-ID hash routes before consumer screens. Prove pure transitions early; actual Back/Forward, focus and browser response-race integration is tested after all consumers exist. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-009` | `proposed` | Processes use supported canonical data and explicit exact source sections, with source attribution. Ordered text is shown only when ordering evidence is unambiguous; otherwise preserve the TRD exact missing-order sentence and documented relationships. No new schema field, invented process content or automatic flow library is needed to satisfy the first release. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-010` | `proposed` | Keep frontend source/build declarations in SKILLS-depo/ontology/explorer. Stage builds privately and publish a reviewed manifest and hashed runtime assets under explorer/assets, which the existing Template updater can ship without relaxing dist/build exclusions. Keep lock, BUILD.md, build identity and notices in the package; only manifest runtime members are HTTP-addressable. Source opens require selected record/reference identities and revalidated no-follow bounded bytes, never browser paths. Exact supported locator content or a clearly labeled bounded excerpt remains escaped and transient. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-011` | `proposed` | Keep implementation, generated Template delivery, inspected root adoption, active workbench retirement, any authorized provenance maintenance and rollback evidence separate. Complete reader/security/isolation acceptance on production assets before normal-entry cutover. Rollback restores approved code/assets/configuration only and preserves newer valid knowledge/history. The current initializer explicitly depends on legacy workbench assets; add an explicit current explorer capability/compatibility path and its completeness tests while preserving historical v9 receipt semantics. Neutral Template startup reports missing specialization honestly or is exercised through a documented disposable specialization, never a fabricated depot identity. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-012` | `proposed` | Treat all TRD D04/D05 layout, latency and fixture numbers as proposed initial evaluation targets. Use manual knowledge tasks and assistive technology checks in addition to automated tests; unavailable Windows/participants remain explicit limitations, and high-impact semantic misunderstandings block usability acceptance. | Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required. |
| `DEC-013` | `proposed` | Evaluate TRD D04 starting values: 224-260 CSS-pixel collapsible rail, 65-75-character reading line, roughly 320-400-pixel map details panel, around 16 CSS-pixel body size, and approximately 44-pixel primary controls as comfort targets. The applicable AA target criterion remains 24 by 24 CSS pixels with exceptions. Tune search debounce near 150-200 ms initially, excluded from warm-search timing. These are subordinate to readability, accessibility and reflow and are not measured or approved layouts. | Qualified implementation-plan proposal preserving TRD D04; exact canonical plan review remains required. |
